blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Long egocentric videos pose a central challenge for multimodal language models: the visual stream must be compressed into a memory representation that can be searched efficiently while still preserving the evidence needed for question answering. Building on an online textual-memory framework in which first-person videos are converted into temporally grounded captions, this work systematically studies the role of retrieval in episodic-memory video question answering. We evaluate how different retrieval units, query formulations, context budgets, and reranking strategies affect multiple-choice answering on QAEgo4D-Closed, isolating retrieval as the main variable while keeping the underlying generated memory fixed.
  Our best configuration, Parent, matches fine-grained caption subchunks, then provides their full parent captions to the reasoner. It achieves 56.4 % accuracy, matching strong full-memory and retrieval baselines while exposing only a small fraction of the textual memory at question time. More importantly, our analysis shows that better temporal coverage does not necessarily translate into better answers: increasing the retrieval budget improves temporal Hit@K and Recall@K, but can reduce accuracy by introducing visually plausible distractors and uncertain caption evidence. These findings suggest that retrieval-augmented egocentric memory should not be optimized only for evidence recall, but also for the reliability, specificity, and answer-discriminative value of the retrieved context. The study motivates more structured episodic memories that move beyond raw caption retrieval toward evidence-aware representations for long-form egocentric reasoning.
blocks.zh:
长长的以自我为中心的视频对多式联运模式构成一个中心挑战:视觉流必须压缩成一个内存代表,可以有效搜索,同时保留回答问题所需的证据. 在将第一人称视频转换成基于时间的字幕的在线文字-记忆框架的基础上,这项工作系统地研究了检索在突发视频问答中的作用。 我们评价不同的检索单位,查询公式,上下文预算,以及重新排序的战略如何影响QAEgo4D-Closed上的多选择回答,将检索隔离为主要变量,同时保持基础生成的内存固定.
我们最好的配置,家长,匹配精细的字幕 子Chunk,然后提供他们 完整的父标题给理性者。 它实现了56.4%的精度,匹配了强烈的全记忆和检索基线,同时在问题时间只暴露了文字内存的一小部分. 更为重要的是,我们的分析表明,时间覆盖的改善并不一定能转化为更好的答案:增加检索预算可以改善时间点击@K和Recall@K,但可以通过引入可视化的可视转移器和不确定的字幕证据来降低准确性。 这些调查结果表明,不应仅仅为了召回证据而优化检索的自我中心记忆,而且还应优化检索的上下文的可靠性、特殊性和回答歧视价值。 这项研究激发了更结构化的零星记忆,这些记忆超越了原始标题检索,而转向对长式自我中心推理的体会到证据的表述。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Egocentric video question answering requires a model to reason over what a
camera wearer saw, did, handled, and encountered across long first-person video
streams. This setting is closely related to artificial episodic memory, where an
agent should recall past events and use them to answer later queries [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
It is also central to wearable assistants, lifelogging, and embodied perception,
where questions may refer to objects, locations, actions, and state changes
observed long before the question is asked [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
However, egocentric video exposes a fundamental scalability problem. A single
recording may contain many visually similar moments, repeated objects, partial
views, camera motion, occlusions, and small state changes. Directly processing
the video at question time is expensive, while reading an entire textual memory
can still exceed practical context budgets and introduce plausible distractors.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Overview of our retrieval-augmented textual-memory pipeline for egocentric video question answering. The egocentric video stream is processed online by a video descriptor model into captions, which are stored in an online textual memory. At question-answering time, the system uses the question and answer options to retrieve the most relevant subchunks, which are expanded to their parent captions and passed to the reasoner to predict the answer.

blocks.en:
Recent work on Online Episodic Memory Video Question Answering (OEM-VQA)
addresses this issue by processing the visual stream sequentially and retaining a
compact memory that can be queried later, rather than reprocessing the full video
for every question [ 7 , 8 ] . Within
this direction, textual-memory approaches convert egocentric clips into language
descriptions, yielding memories that are compact, human-readable, and reusable
across multiple queries [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 8 ] . Prior work has shown that such memories can match dedicated
state-of-the-art systems on QAEgo4D-Closed while using substantially less memory
than approaches that retain visual features or cache large video representations [ 3 , 7 , 8 ] . This makes textual memory an appealing substrate for scalable
and inspectable egocentric reasoning.

blocks.en:
This paper builds on this textual-memory paradigm and studies a narrower but
crucial question: once the visual stream has been compressed into textual memory,
which parts of that memory should be provided to the reasoner at query time?
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , our pipeline separates online memory
construction from question-time retrieval and reasoning. Video clips are first
converted into captions and stored in an online textual memory. When a question
arrives, the system retrieves relevant subchunks and expands them to their parent
captions, providing the reasoner with compact but contextual evidence.

blocks.en:
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) was introduced to equip large language models with explicit non-parametric memory [ 9 ] . In episodic video QA, however, retrieval does more
than reduce context length, it changes the evidence distribution seen by the
reasoner. A retrieval module must recover the relevant event, preserve enough
surrounding context to disambiguate the answer options, and avoid introducing
visually plausible but incorrect evidence from other moments in the same video.

而不是缩小上下文长度,它改变
说理者. 一个检索模块必须恢复相关的事件, 保存足够
环绕上下文,以区分答案选项,避免引入
同一视频中其他时刻的可信但不正确的证据。

blocks.en:
We therefore isolate retrieval as the main object of study. All configurations
operate on the same generated textual memory and differ only in how memory
entries are indexed, retrieved, transformed, or passed to the reasoner. We compare
flat caption retrieval, subchunk retrieval, parent retrieval, hybrid
dense–lexical retrieval, and reranking strategies. Our strongest configuration
uses Parent retrieval: captions are split into fine-grained subchunks
for embedding and matching, but the corresponding full parent captions are
provided to the reasoner. This strategy reaches 56.4% accuracy on
QAEgo4D-Closed, matching strong state-of-the-art baselines while using only
3,600 tokens per query on average.

blocks.en:
The main finding of our study is that retrieval quality and answer accuracy do
not improve monotonically together. Increasing the number of retrieved captions
raises temporal Hit@K and Recall@K, but answer accuracy peaks earlier and then
declines. In long egocentric videos, additional retrieved context often contains
repeated objects, similar locations, uncertain descriptions, or actions that are
semantically close to the question but correspond to the wrong moment. As a
result, a reasoner may become less reliable even when the retrieved set covers
more of the annotated evidence window. This suggests that episodic-memory QA
should not optimize retrieval only for temporal coverage, but also for the
specificity and answer-discriminative value of the retrieved evidence.
blocks.zh:
我们研究的主要结论是 检索质量和答案准确性
不单调地一起改善。 增加已检索标题的数量

重复对象、类似位置、不确定描述或动作

结果,即使检索到的套装封面,一个原因也可能变得不那么可靠
更多附加说明的证据窗口。 这说明 典型的QA
不仅应优化时间范围检索,而且应优化
所取证据的具体性和答复性价值。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold: • We provide a systematic retrieval-centred study for textual-memory
OEM-VQA, explicitly building on prior training-free memory construction
pipelines and isolating retrieval as the main variable. • We compare multiple retrieval units, context budgets, and ranking
strategies on QAEgo4D-Closed, showing that Parent retrieval provides
the best trade-off between fine-grained matching and contextual reasoning. • We analyze the mismatch between temporal retrieval metrics and final
answer accuracy, showing that higher evidence coverage can introduce hard
distractors and reduce the reliability of the final reasoner.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Egocentric Video Question Answering
blocks.zh: II-A 爱果中心视频问答

blocks.en:
Episodic memory in egocentric vision concerns the ability to answer questions
about past first-person observations, such as where an object was placed, which
action was performed, or what happened before or after a given event [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Ego4D
formalized this problem through the Natural Language Queries (NLQ) benchmark,
where models must localize the temporal segment containing the evidence needed
to answer a natural-language query [ 2 ] .
Early work on episodic-memory QA further studied open-ended question answering
over egocentric videos [ 10 ] , while Ground VQA introduced grounded
question answering in long egocentric videos and the QAEgo4D-Closed
multiple-choice setting [ 3 ] . This formulation reduces the
ambiguity of free-form answer evaluation, but still requires models to identify
the relevant moment and distinguish the correct answer from plausible
distractors.

blocks.en:
Recent work has increasingly focused on long-horizon and memory-based
egocentric understanding [ 7 , 11 , 5 , 6 , 8 ] . MM-Ego studies egocentric multimodal LLMs for video QA
and highlights the difficulty of preserving visual details over long first-person
videos [ 11 ] . Streaming video-language models such as
VideoLLM-online address online video understanding by processing video streams
incrementally rather than assuming that the full video can be reprocessed at
query time [ 7 ] . Complementary textual-memory approaches
decouple perception and reasoning by converting observed clips into language
descriptions and answering later questions over the accumulated memory [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 8 ] . Our work builds on this textual-memory paradigm, but
focuses specifically on retrieval: given an existing temporally grounded textual
memory, we study which evidence should be selected and provided to the reasoner
at query time.

blocks.en: II-B Video Retrieval-Augmented Generation
blocks.zh: II-B 视频检索-增强生成

blocks.en:
Retrieval-augmented generation was introduced as a way to combine parametric
language models with explicit non-parametric memory [ 9 ] .
In video understanding, this idea becomes more challenging because retrieval must
also handle temporal grounding and modality compression. DrVideo converts long
videos into document-like representations and retrieves relevant textual evidence
to support long-video understanding [ 12 ] . Video-RAG similarly
uses retrieval-augmented mechanisms to improve long-video comprehension by
selecting auxiliary visual-textual evidence before generation [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] .
Our work is complementary to these video RAG systems. Rather than training or
designing a new video model, we isolate retrieval within an online textual-memory
pipeline whose captions have already been generated from the egocentric stream.
This allows us to study how retrieval units, query formulation, context budget,
and memory format affect downstream multiple-choice answering. In this setting,
retrieval is not only a way to reduce context length, it determines the evidence
distribution seen by the reasoner and can therefore improve or degrade answer
selection depending on the relevance and reliability of the retrieved captions.

在视频理解中,这个想法变得更具挑战性,因为检索必须
还处理时间定位和方式压缩。 DrVideo 转换长

支持长视频理解 [12]. 类似视频RAG

这样我们就可以研究检索单元、查询设置、上下文预算

blocks.en: II-C Memory Structures for Long Context Reasoning
blocks.zh: II-C 长语境内存结构

blocks.en:
Textual memory is attractive for long-form egocentric reasoning because it is
compact, human-readable, easy to index, and reusable across multiple queries.
However, the structure of the memory determines what can be recovered at query
time. Long-context memory systems have shown that retrieval can benefit from
organizing information beyond independent chunks, for instance through
hippocampal-inspired memory and graph-based associations [ 16 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
文字记忆对长形自我中心推理很有吸引力,因为它
紧凑,人可读,易于索引,在多个查询中重复使用.
然而,内存的结构决定了在查询时可以回收什么
时间 长文本内存系统表明,检索可以获益于
组织超越独立块的信息,例如通过
河马鼓动的记忆和以图表为基础的协会[16,17].

blocks.en:
This issue is especially important in egocentric video, where many questions are
not answered by object presence alone, but by temporal and relational context:
where an object appeared, when it was manipulated, what action preceded it, or
how it related to other objects and locations [ 3 , 18 , 19 ] . For this reason, we analyze how retrieval over caption-based memories succeeds or fails when questions require temporally grounded object, action, and location evidence. Our results suggest that useful memory should preserve entities together with temporal anchors, actions, and locations [ 18 , 20 ] , but also keep the retrieved textual context compact. This indicates that caption-based episodic memories should optimize not only for evidence recall, but also for token efficiency, context specificity, and answer-discriminative value.
blocks.zh:
这个问题在以自我为中心的视频中特别重要,其中有许多问题。
不单凭物体存在,而是按时间和关系背景回答:
在物体出现时,当物体被操纵时,在物体出现之前应采取何种行动,或
与其他物体和地点[3、18、19]的关系如何。 因此,当问题需要基于时间的物体、动作和位置证据时,我们分析如何在基于标题的记忆上检索成败。 我们的结果表明,有用的记忆应该与时间锚点、行动、地点[18、20]一起保存实体,但也保持检索到的文字上下文紧凑。 这表明,基于标题的瞬间记忆不仅应优化对证据的回顾,而且还应优化象征性的效率、上下文的特异性和回答歧视价值。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : Overview of the proposed retrieval-augmented online textual-memory pipeline. The video stream is processed incrementally by a descriptor model into captions, which are then chunked, embedded, and stored in a vector database. At question-answering time, the query and candidate answers are used to retrieve relevant memory entries, which are provided to the reasoner to predict the final answer.
blocks.zh: 图2:拟议检索的在线文字-记忆管道概述。 视频流由描述器模型递增处理成标题,然后进行块化、嵌入和存储在矢量数据库中。 在问答时间,查询和候选答案被用来检索相关的内存条目,这些条目提供给了理性者来预测最终答案.

blocks.en:
Our retrieval-augmented formulation builds on the online textual-memory
pipeline introduced in [ 8 ] , where egocentric video clips are
processed incrementally into a compact textual memory and later queried by a
language-model reasoner. We extend this formulation by indexing the generated
captions and retrieving a query-specific subset of memory entries before
answering multiple-choice questions. The overall pipeline is shown in Fig. 2 . It is
organized into three main stages: an Online Memory Constructor , a Memory Manager , and a QA Handler .
Given an incoming video stream, clips are processed incrementally. For each new
clip, a multimodal descriptor model produces a natural-language caption. The
caption is then passed to a chunking module, which decomposes it into smaller
textual chunks, and each chunk is embedded by a text embedding model
(Fig. 2 (a)).
Each chunk is stored with its temporal metadata and embedding in a vector database
(Fig. 2 (b)). At question-answering time, the input question and
the candidate answers are used to form a retrieval query. A context retriever
performs similarity search over the vector database and returns a retrieved
context. Finally, a language-model reasoner receives the question, the candidate

pipeline explicitly separates caption generation, chunk construction,
embedding, indexing, retrieval, and reasoning.

blocks.en: III-H Evaluation
blocks.zh: 三-H 评价

blocks.en:
We report answer accuracy as the percentage of questions for which the predicted answer matches the ground-truth answer.
For retrieval diagnostics, we also report temporal Hit@K and Recall@K against the annotated evidence region of each question. Hit@ K K measures whether at least one of the top- K K retrieved memory entries overlaps with the annotated evidence region for the question. Recall@ K K measures how much of the annotated evidence region is covered by the temporal intervals of the top- K K retrieved entries.
By construction, Hit@K ≥ \geq Recall@K, since Hit@K only requires a single overlapping entry while Recall@K measures the covered fraction of the evidence window.

我们报告答案准确性是预测答案与地面真相答案相符的问题的百分比。
关于检索诊断,我们还报告Time Hit@K和Recall@ K与每个问题的附加说明的证据区域相对。 点击@ KK 测量至少一个顶端的 K K 检索到的内存条目是否与问题附加说明的证据区域重叠 。 回顾@ K K 测量标注的证据区域中, K 检索到的顶端条目的时间间隔覆盖了多少 。
通过构建 Hit@K\geq Recall@K,因为 Hit@K只需要一个重叠的条目,而Recall@K则测量证据窗口的覆盖部分。

blocks.en: Together, these diagnostics evaluate the temporal quality of the retrieval module, while answer accuracy measures the performance of the full retrieval-augmented reasoning pipeline.
blocks.zh: 这些诊断方法共同评价了检索模块的时间质量,同时答案准确度测量了完整检索增强推理管道的性能.

blocks.zh: 表格 I: 使用K=12K=12块的固定检索预算,在QAEGE4D-关闭上对拟议的RAG配置进行校对.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 四. 实验结果和分析

blocks.en:
This section reports the experimental results on the QAEgo4D-Closed [ 3 ] test set and analyzes how retrieval design affects both temporal evidence coverage and final answer accuracy.
All experiments use Qwen3-VL-8B [ 21 ] as the descriptor model and Gemini 2.5 Flash [ 22 ] as the reasoner model, with temperature set to 0 and structured JSON decoding.
Each video is processed in a streaming setting using non-overlapping clips of 15 15 seconds.
blocks.zh:
本节报告QAEGO4D-Closed [3]测试集的实验结果,并分析检索设计如何影响时间证据覆盖范围和最终答案准确性.
所有实验都使用Qune3-VL-8B[21]作为描述模型,双子座2.5 Flash[22]作为理性模型,温度设定为0,结构化的JSON解码.
每段视频在流媒体中处理,使用15-15秒的非重叠片段。

blocks.en:
We use the captioning pipeline and resulting textual memory described in [ 8 ] , keeping the memory fixed across all experiments.
Dense retrieval uses llama-3.2-nemoretriever-300m-embed-v1 [ 23 ] . Similarity is computed as cosine similarity, equivalently as dot product over normalized embeddings. The retrieval query is formed by concatenating the question with all answer options. Unless otherwise specified, we use a retrieval budget of K = 12 K=12 .
For Parent -based methods, we retrieve 36 36 subchunks and keep up to K = 12 K=12 unique parent chunks as the final context before passing the context to the reasoner to ensure a fair comparison with other methods. Hybrid combines dense retrieval and BM25 using reciprocal rank fusion with k 0 = 60 k_{0}=60 . Parent-Time applies a temporal cutoff to model the strictly online setting, retrieving only memory available up to the evidence time, serving as a diagnostic test. Reranking uses nvidia/rerank-qa-mistral-4b [ 24 ] before parent expansion: Parent-Rerank reranks the same candidate pool as Parent , preserving the selected parents and temporal metric.
blocks.zh:
我们使用[8]中描述的字幕管道和由此产生的文字内存,将内存固定在所有实验中.
腾讯检索使用lama-3.2-nemoretriever-300m-embed-v1 [23]. 相似性被计算为同位素相似性,相当于点产物与正常嵌入物相比. 检索查询是通过将问题与所有答案选项结合而形成的. 除非另有说明,我们使用K=12K=12的检索预算。
对于基于亲子的方法,我们回收了36,36个子堆,并保持K = 12 K = 12个独特的亲子块作为最后上下文,然后将上下文传递给理性,以确保与其他方法进行公平的比较。 Hybrid结合了密集的检索和BM25,使用对等的等级核聚变,k = 60 k_{0}=60. 家长-时间应用时间截断来模拟严格的在线设定,只检索到证据时间为止的可用内存,作为诊断测试. 重排使用 nvidia/rerank-qa-mistral-4b [24] 在父扩展前: 父母-Rank对与父母相同的候选人组合重新排序,保留了选定的父母和时间尺度。

blocks.zh: 图5:检索-强化生成行为定性实例.

blocks.en: IV-A Analysis of Retrieval Strategies
blocks.zh: 四-A 检索战略分析

blocks.en:
Table I reports the ablation of the proposed RAG configurations using a fixed retrieval budget of K = 12 K=12 retrieved units.
The best result is obtained by Parent , which reaches 56.4% accuracy, with a Hit@K of 79.0% and a Recall@K of 70.7%.
The second-best configuration is Flat , which achieves a comparable accuracy of 55.6% with slightly higher Hit@K and Recall@K.
This suggests that flat retrieval is already competitive when the retrieved captions contain sufficient context, while the parent strategy provides a better balance between precise matching and contextual grounding.
blocks.zh:
表一报告使用K=12K=12检索单元的固定检索预算对拟议的RAG配置进行了缩减。
最好的结果由家长获得,准确度达到56.4%,点击率达到79.0%,重回率达到70.7%。
第二佳配置为Flat ,其可比较精度达到55.6%,略高的Hit@K和Recall@K.
这表明当检索到的标题包含足够的上下文时,平面检索已经具有竞争性,而母策略则在精确匹配和上下文定位之间提供了更好的平衡.

blocks.en:
Interestingly, Sub-Rerank obtains the strongest retrieval scores among the tested configurations, with the highest Hit@K and Recall@K.
However, this does not translate into the best final accuracy.
This gap indicates that retrieving more relevant subchunks is not sufficient by itself, since the reasoner also needs enough surrounding information to correctly interpret the evidence and select the answer.
In this sense, retrieval granularity plays a central role.
Fine-grained subchunks are useful for locating the relevant moment, but using them alone can fragment the context available to the model.
Conversely, parent captions preserve the temporal and semantic context around the matched evidence, leading to more robust answer generation.
blocks.zh:
有趣的是,Sub-Rank在测试的配置中获得了最强的检索分数,其中Hit@K和Recall@K最高.
然而,这并没有转化为最好的最终准确性。
这一缺口表明,检索更相关的子丘本身是不够的,因为理性者还需要足够的周边信息来正确解释证据和选择答案.
在这个意义上,检索颗粒性起着中心作用.
精细的子丘对定位相关瞬间很有用,但单用它们就可以分割模型可用的上下文.
反之,母标题保留了对应证据周围的时间和语义上下文,导致更强的答案生成.

blocks.en: Overall, the results show that the most effective strategy is not simply the one with the highest retrieval metrics, but the one that best couples retrieval precision with readable context.
blocks.zh: 总体来看,结果显示,最有效的战略不仅仅是有最高检索度量标准的战略,而是有可读背景的最好夫妇检索精度的战略。

blocks.en: IV-B Retrieval Budget and Temporal Coverage
blocks.zh: 四-B 回收预算和临时保险

blocks.en:
Figure 4 reports the retrieval budget curve for the best-performing Parent configuration.
Increasing K K steadily improves temporal coverage: Hit@K rises from 53.4% to 98.2%, and Recall@K rises from 42.7% to 97.9%.
Accuracy, however, follows a different trend.
It peaks at 56.4% for K = 12 K=12 , then decreases as additional captions are included.
blocks.zh:
图4报告最佳家长配置的检索预算曲线。
KK稳步提高时间覆盖率:hit@K从53.4%上升到98.2%,Recall@K从42.7%上升到97.9%。
然而,准确性的趋势有所不同。
K = 12 K = 12,峰值为56.4%,然后由于增加了标题而减少。

blocks.en:
This result highlights that temporal recall is useful but not sufficient for answer accuracy.
In egocentric video, repeated rooms, objects, screens, tables, and actions create plausible hard negatives.
A larger retrieved context can therefore cover more of the annotated evidence while also introducing distractors that make option selection harder for the reasoner.
blocks.zh:
这一结果突出表明,时间召回是有用的,但不足以准确回答。
在以自我为中心的视频中,重复的房间、物品、屏幕、桌子和动作会产生可信的硬底片。
因此,更大的检索上下文可以涵盖更多的附加说明的证据,同时也可以引入分散视线,使选择选择更难于解释。

blocks.en: IV-C Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en:
TABLE II : Comparison with state-of-the-art methods on QAEgo4D-Closed.
For methods based on MLLMs, we report the number of tokens used at query time.
blocks.zh:
表二:与QAEGE4D-Closed上最先进的方法比较.
对于基于 MLLMs 的方法,我们报告查询时使用的符号数.

blocks.en:
Table II compares our best-performing configuration with recent state-of-the-art methods on QAEgo4D-Closed [ 3 ] . Parent reaches 56.4% accuracy, which is on par with the best previously reported result, 56.0%, obtained by the Gemini-based pipeline proposed in [ 8 ] .
The main advantage of our approach is its substantially lower query-time token usage.
While the Gemini-based method of [ 8 ] uses the full textual memory, corresponding to 10,880 tokens at query time, our method requires only 3,600 tokens on average.
This corresponds to roughly 33% of the full-memory input.
Moreover, our memory footprint remains in the KB/min range, with 66.07 KB/min, whereas visual-memory and KV-cache-based methods such as Ground VQA [ 3 ] and ReKV [ 7 ] operate in the MB/min range.
Although these memory measurements are not directly equivalent across methods, since they represent different memory representations, they highlight that our textual-memory approach remains compact while being competitive with substantially heavier visual-memory baselines.
blocks.zh:
表二 将我们最佳的配置与最近QAEGE4D-Closed [3] 的先进方法进行比较. 父母的准确度达到56.4%,与先前报告的最佳结果(56.0%)相同,这是由[8]中提议的双子体管道获得的。
我们的方法的主要优点是它使用查询时间大大降低。
虽然基于双子座的方法[8]使用完整的文字内存,相当于查询时间的10,880个符,但我们的方法平均只需要3,600个符.
这大约相当于全模输入的33%.
此外,我们的记忆足迹仍然在KB/min范围内,有66.07KB/min,而基于视觉记忆和KV-cache的方法,如Ground VQA[3]和ReKV[7]在MB/min范围内运作。
虽然这些内存测量方法并不直接等同,因为它们代表着不同的内存表示,但它们强调,我们的文字-记忆方法仍然紧凑,同时与明显重的视觉-记忆基线竞争。

blocks.en: IV-D Qualitative Examples
blocks.zh: 四-D 定性实例

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows representative success and failure cases of our RAG pipeline.
In the success case, the retrieved captions explicitly mention the target object and its location, allowing the model to answer that the scissors were placed on the table correctly.
In the failure case, the retrieved captions are semantically related to the query, but only provide coarse evidence about the knife being near the sink.
As a result, the model predicts “in the sink” instead of the more precise ground-truth location, “in the strainer.”
These examples suggest that our method is effective when retrieved captions contain explicit evidence, but suffers from missing or ambiguous fine-grained spatial details.
blocks.zh:
图5显示了我们RAG管道具有代表性的成功和失败案例。
在成功的情况下,检索到的字幕明确提到目标对象及其位置,使模型能够回答剪刀放在桌子上是正确的.
在失败的情况下,检索到的字幕与查询有密切的关系,但只提供了刀子靠近水槽的粗糙证据.
因此,模型预测的是“在水槽中”,而不是“在教练器中”更精确的地面真实位置。 “
这些例子表明,当检索到的字幕包含明确的证据时,我们的方法是有效的,但有缺失或模糊的细纹空间细节。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
This study presented a training-free textual-memory pipeline for egocentric video question answering.
Our best configuration, Parent , retrieves fine-grained caption subchunks and expands them to their parent captions, achieving 56.4% accuracy on QAEgo4D-Closed while using a substantially smaller query-time context than full-memory reasoning.
blocks.zh:
这项研究提供了一个免费的文字-记忆管道,用于回答以自我为中心的视频问题。
我们的最佳配置是“家长”检索精细的字幕,并将其扩展为母字幕,在QAEgo4D-Closed上达到56.4%的精度,同时使用比全模推理小得多的查询时间。

blocks.en:
Our analysis shows that temporal retrieval coverage does not necessarily translate into better answer accuracy.
As the retrieval budget increases, Hit@K and Recall@K continue to improve, but accuracy peaks at an intermediate budget, since additional captions can introduce plausible distractors in long egocentric videos with repeated objects, locations, and actions.
blocks.zh:
我们的分析表明,时间检索范围并不一定会转化为更好的答案准确性。
随着检索预算的增加, Hit@K和Recall@ K继续改进,但准确性在中间预算中达到顶峰,因为额外的字幕可以在长长的自我中心视频中引入令人难以置信的分心器,并带有重复的对象、地点和行动。

blocks.en:
These findings highlight the importance of retrieval design in textual-memory-based egocentric QA.
Future work should move beyond treating captions as independent text units and develop evidence-aware episodic memories that preserve temporally grounded events, uncertainty, and answer-relevant support for downstream reasoning.
blocks.zh:
这些发现突出了检索设计在文字-记忆-自我中心QA中的重要性.
今后的工作应超越将标题作为独立的文本单位对待,并发展了解证据的瞬间记忆,以保存基于时间的事件、不确定性以及对下游推理的回答相关支持。
